scope: Predicts channel, committed_count, or committed_sum for a fresh action sequence by simulating all 18 family members (put mode x channel x trigger) and keeping those consistent with calibration receipts; resolves only when all consistent candidates agree.
lesson: The calibration receipts show put on existing key yields channel 2 with committed_sum 2, indicating REPLACE or UPSERT (not IGNORE). The rollback receipt shows channel 2 with committed_sum 1, meaning the first put (value 1) contributed 1 to channel and the rolled-back put contributed 1, consistent with total_changes or changes() where the second put still counted. The other-connection receipt shows channel 2, so channel includes other connection's changes (total_both) or the second put on other connection counted. The begin/put/put/commit receipt shows channel 2 with committed_sum 47, meaning two puts inside transaction each counted 1, and final value 47 (REPLACE or UPSERT). These narrow candidates; the simulator generalizes to new sequences.
